_readme: Playtest cards and rulings. They only appear on the playtest site (playtest.xwingarchives.com), each tagged 'Playtest'. Entries with "sample": true are made-up examples for trying out the look on staging: open staging.xwingarchives.com and click 'Preview the playtest site' in the banner. Cards: id, name, type (Pilot/Upgrade), and either 'base' (an existing pilot's card id: a new pilot reuses its ship, faction, stats, actions, dial and ship ability, but not its pilot traits) or the fields themselves; then text, initiative, limited, slot, factions. Rulings: id, q (question), a (list of answer paragraphs), cards (card ids, playtest or existing), date, topic.

cards.name: Sample Playtest Pilot
cards.text: SAMPLE CARD (not a real card). After you perform a {barrelroll} action, you may gain 1 strain token to acquire a lock on an enemy ship at range 1-2.

cards.text: SAMPLE CARD (not a real card). While you perform a {frontarc} attack, if the defender is in your {bullseyearc}, you may spend 1 strain token to change 1 {focus} result to a {hit} result.

rulings.q: SAMPLE RULING. Can Sample Playtest Talent be used during a bonus attack, such as one granted by Snap Shot?
a: No. This is a made-up answer to show how playtest rulings look. Snap Shot's attack says your dice cannot be modified.

rulings.q: SAMPLE RULING. If Sample Playtest Pilot performs a {barrelroll} action as a red action, can it still use its ability?
a: Yes. This is a made-up answer to show how playtest rulings look. The ability only requires that the action was performed.
